test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 22 Sept 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: A sphere and a cube have the same surface area. The ratio of the volume of the sphere to that of the cube is:
solution:
**Given:**

A sphere and a cube have the same surface area.

**Formula used:**

Surface area of sphere = 4πr²

Surface area of cube = 6a²

Volume of sphere = (4/3)πr³

Volume of cube = a³

**Calculation:**

Given 4πr² = 6a²

⇒ r² = (3/2π)a²

⇒ r = a√(3/2π)

Volume of sphere = (4/3)πr³

⇒ (4/3)π[a√(3/2π)]³

⇒ (4/3)π[a³(3/2π)³/²]

⇒ (4/3)π[a³(√(27/8π³))]

⇒ (4/3)π[a³(3√(3)/2π³/²)]

⇒ (4/3) × (3√(3)/2) × (a³/π¹/²)

⇒ 2√(3)a³/√π

Volume of cube = a³

Ratio of volume of sphere to volume of cube = (2√(3)a³/√π) / a³

⇒ 2√(3)/√π

⇒ √(6)/√π

**∴ The correct answer is option (2).**
